name: Issuer Meeting
definition: Information about the meeting, specifying the participation requirements and the voting procedures.

IssuerMeetingIdentification.name: Issuer Meeting Identification
IssuerMeetingIdentification.definition: Identification assigned to a meeting by the issuer. It must be unique for the issuer.

NomineePowerOfAttorneyIndicator.name: Nominee Power Of Attorney Indicator
NomineePowerOfAttorneyIndicator.definition: Indicates that a power of attorney must be provided by the beneficial owner to the nominee in order for the nominee to vote on behalf of the beneficial owner.

NomineeVotingIndicator.name: Nominee Voting Indicator
NomineeVotingIndicator.definition: Indicates whether an agent can vote on behalf of the beneficial owners.

NomineeBeneficialOwnerIndicator.name: Nominee Beneficial Owner Indicator
NomineeBeneficialOwnerIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the beneficiary details, for example, name and address, must be supplied in order to take part in the event.

ProxyVotingIndicator.name: Proxy Voting Indicator
ProxyVotingIndicator.definition: Indicates that the beneficial owner may give authority to a third party to vote on his behalf.

ProxyBeneficialOwnerIndicator.name: Proxy Beneficial Owner Indicator
ProxyBeneficialOwnerIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the beneficiary details of the proxy, for example, name and address, must be supplied in order to take part in the event.

ProxyPowerOfAttorneyIndicator.name: Proxy Power Of Attorney Indicator
ProxyPowerOfAttorneyIndicator.definition: Indicates that a power of attorney must be provided by the beneficial owner to the proxy in order for the proxy to vote on behalf of the beneficial owner.

ValidCreditorIndicator.name: Valid Creditor Indicator
ValidCreditorIndicator.definition: Indicates that the participant must be a creditor of the company in order to vote on the resolutions of the meeting.

CapitalStock.name: Capital Stock
CapitalStock.definition: Total amount of stock, common or preferred, that a corporation has issued uder its certificate of incorporation or charter.
